Read this first. Match the person's profession against **Name** and **Also called**,
then open only that one file. If more than one row fits ("nurse" could be a registered
nurse, an LPN, a nurse practitioner, or a nursing assistant), ask one short question
with the candidates as clickable options before opening anything. If nothing fits,
carry on without an archetype and say nothing about it.

Codes used in the archetypes: SOC is the US Standard Occupational Classification; OEWS is
the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics survey (the pay
figures); NOC is Canada's National Occupational Classification.
